notes.title: Welcome to the DISRUPTION Playtest Community
notes.notes:
[h2]Help Us Get Ready for Steam Next Fest[/h2]
The Outnumbered Games Dev team is psyched for DISRUPTION in Steam's Summer Next Fest entry starting on June 13th, 2022. And for those of you players with a critical eye, here's where you can help our Dev Team with your astute eye to gameplay, detail and overall quality.
[h2]The DISRUPTION Demo[/h2]
The demo currently consists of an Introduction and (4) abbreviated levels (not necessarily in order) from Act I of the game. 
[olist]
[*] Rooftop Raid
[*] Watch Your Step
[*] Nowhere to Run
[*] Subway Station
[/olist]
This is essentially the same demo structure as we will be featuring in Next Fest, so playtesters are getting access before everyone else on June 13th.
[h2]Items Dev are focusing on for this playtest[/h2]
[list]
[*] Show stopping bugs
[*] Controller Responsiveness
[*] Gameplay Flow
[*] Lighting and color
[*] Weapon load-outs
[*] General Impressions
[/list]
[h2]Not so critical as we're already working on tuning these[/h2]
[list]
[*] General collider issues
[*] Occlusion culling issues
[/list]
[h2]Your Feedback is Important to Us[/h2]
Do you dig the demo? Let us know! Do you have snarky, horrible things to say about DISRUPTION. Cool. Hit us with your most brutally clever and spirit-crushing critiques.
[h2] Join us on Discord[/h2]
You are invited to join us on Outnumbered Game’s Discord Channel we created for the DISRUPTION Playtest here: [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/715654778893631528/973686499377832057]Discord DISRUPTION Playtest Channel[/url]
